subject: Commercial onboarding: QuillTech referral ladder, demo credits, and reseller invoicing flow
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara@quilltech.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@quilltech.com
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring a referral + reseller pilot with Redwood

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the convo at Re:Build — QuillTech's marketplace team is excited about embedding Redwood inference into our admin workflow. We'd like to scope a small pilot that includes: a referral path for our sales team, a trial reseller flow for 10 customers, and a demo-credit budget to accelerate proofs-of-concept.

High-level asks:
- Commission mix: referral credit for intro vs. reseller margin for closed sales
- Lead registration window and proof-of-intro requirements
- Simple SOW we can review and route to procurement (we can present a consolidated SOW to our legal team)

Can you loop in the person who owns partner credits and the legal intake? We'll follow up with a partner map doc.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
QuillTech

Attachments: QuillTech-Partner-Map-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 132KB)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara@quilltech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring a referral + reseller pilot with Redwood

Sara — great to hear and congrats on the momentum. I'm cc'ing Marissa (partner ops) and Mateo (partner AM) to handle commercial terms and onboarding. Quick answers up front:

- Commission structure: we can offer a 7% referral credit on ARR for pure intro credits, or a 12% reseller margin split for deals where QuillTech handles billing and first-level support. We typically tier after $250k ARR.
- Lead registration: 90-day claim window; we require the initial intro email thread + meeting notes and lead registration form (we'll send a link).
- Demo credits: we can allocate a 50k token demo pool for the pilot, consumed at host rates; unused credits expire at the pilot end.

Marissa — can you attach the partner intake + SOW template and confirm who will own the invoice routing for reseller scenarios?

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sara Khan <sara@quilltech.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring a referral + reseller pilot with Redwood

Thanks — attaching the intake and SOW template for review. A few operational clarifications:

1) Reseller invoicing flow:
   - If QuillTech resells (you handle billing), Redwood issues a monthly usage statement to QuillTech. QuillTech invoices customers under your T&C and pays Redwood per the agreed margin.
   - For credit/commission accounting we need an initial kickoff with finance to map invoice cadence and net terms (we typically do Net30 for pilot partners).

2) Lead registration & anti-duplication:
   - Lead form + timestamped email thread are sufficient. If a lead is already in our CRM in a nurturing stage, we may request co-marketing engagement rather than referral credit.

3) Demo credits & measurement:
   - We'll provide a shared dashboard for credit consumption; Marissa will be primary contact for credits allocation and expiration.

I've attached: redwood-partner-factsheet.pdf and the SOW template (QTL-SOW-redlines.docx). Sara, please send back any redlines to legal@quilltech.com and cc us so we can expedite.

Attachments: redwood-partner-factsheet.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB); QTL-SOW-redlines.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 24KB)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
From: QuillTech Legal <legal@quilltech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara@quilltech.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QTL SOW redlines and billing party

Marissa / Kimberly — attaching redlines to the SOW. Primary items:
- Define reseller vs referral accounting language (who bears chargebacks and refunds)
- Require an audit clause for consumption reporting (QuillTech needs monthly usage reports to reconcile customer-billed amounts)
- Need clarity on data residency for customer content in pilot (US region only)

We propose the following workflow to keep procurement moving:
1) Redwood provides a short addendum that clarifies invoicing cadence and refund responsibilities.
2) QuillTech counters with any last commercial asks within 48 hours.
3) Parties sign SOW + addendum, then kick off pilot.

Attachment: QTL-SOW-redlines.docx (redlines embedded)

—QuillTech Legal
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara@quilltech.com>, legal@quilltech.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding: QuillTech referral ladder, demo credits, and reseller invoicing flow

Team — summary and action items to close this pilot by next week:

1) Marissa: please draft the one-page invoicing addendum that explicitly states: reseller billing responsibilities, refund / chargeback ownership, Net30 terms for pilot, and monthly usage reporting cadence. Attach to SOW and upload to the Drive folder. (ETA: EOD Tue 9/7)
2) Mateo: book a 30-min kickoff with QuillTech engineering to confirm data residency and basic onboarding steps; include our SRE contact for any network whitelisting. (ETA: Mon 9/6)
3) Sara / QuillTech: please confirm acceptance of the 50k demo-credit pool and that you'll complete the partner intake form in the Drive folder.
4) Kimberly: I'll track HubSpot HS-93472 and follow up with procurement if legal requests push timeline.

If we hit these asks we can sign and start the pilot in the week of 9/13.

Thanks — let's keep pressure on the SOW timeline; Marissa, loop product billing if you need custom invoice fields.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

P.S. Quick note: attach local tax ID if QuillTech expects invoices to show reseller VAT handling.
